title: SoakSourceProviderLocator
description: A runtime contract that tells a source-provider HOW to resolve a fact to a concrete citation, WITHOUT committing the citation. The committed contract is public-safe: it names an abstract provider and query shape only. Resolved citations, proprietary paths/symbols/lines, and effective config are written to the gitignored eval-runs/ tree, never into this manifest.

provider_kind.description: Abstract class of the private/external provider. No provider endpoints or paths are encoded here.

query_shape.description: Public-safe description of the lookup the provider performs (e.g. 'symbol-name search in control-plane validation module'). MUST NOT contain a concrete path, symbol, or line.

destination.description: Resolved citations MUST land in the gitignored eval-runs tree only.

path_template.description: Template for where the runtime writes the resolved citation. Relative to repo root under the gitignored eval-runs/ tree.

redaction_policy.description: Public-safe statement of what the provider must strip before any value leaves eval-runs (paths, symbols, lines, endpoints, subscriptions, effective config).

public_safe.description: Asserts this committed contract contains no proprietary source, paths, symbols, lines, endpoints, or effective config.
